decision.observation: 11 mph, gear R, timer 33:58.069, no red X. The reverse carried the car clear out of the trees and back onto the gravel — it sits just right of centre, nose up-frame and pointing along the track; the road curves left ahead past white posts, with a red/white hut visible up-left and the orange tree on the right.
decision.hypothesis: Fifth successful S+A rejoin, and this one retained 11 mph. Gear is still R, so plain W must convert it first; the conversion usually bleeds a few mph but leaves the car rolling up the road.
decision.memory: Longer S+A holds (1.5 s) back the car all the way onto the gravel without a separate follow-up; always convert the gear with plain W before any steering.
